order: 2 Ambulance list on every message while Graf is on (D31), in all three scripts regardless of request.language, before register and before the knowledge snapshot. Tiers (safety.json match_spec.ambulance_tiers): strong hit → 103 text (emergency.*), status limited, no product, empty selection; weak hit or negated strong hit → emergency.check, status clarification. Reply to emergency.check (templates continuation.check_map): yes or unparsed → 103; no → the message before the check continues from step 3 with ambulance hits ignored for it. Only this list runs on named-product questions.

3 Continuation: if the last history answer starts with a Graf acknowledgement variant AND contains a Graf question (templates.json continuation.ack_map + question_map), Graf owns the turn before resolve(). Situation from the ack, slot from the question; the reply is parsed by that slot's parser (safety.json parsers). The doctor lists and doctor_rules_with_slots run on this reply too, with the slots known at that point (review r3 I5), before the next question or the offer. Unparsed reply → one Jev call on the reply alone: a different situation at >= 0.7 starts a new flow, otherwise one re-ask (counted from history), then the no-product answer. Start pair outside the 4-pair window → step aside.
4 Named or displayed product (subject.explicit or a non-empty selection) → existing path, unchanged. An open product page alone does NOT stop Graf.

5.1 Jev: one Choice over the 46 situations with jev_criterion_full (unchanged since r2); state = the message; timeout 3 s; accept only a response model starting with typesafe/jev-1.14 (or a pinned 1.14 id).

5.2 Below 0.7, error or timeout → step aside. Version mismatch → step aside and one log line without customer text (D32 3). 'unclear' → step aside. 'other_unhandled' → uncovered_mode (D30: no_product_template).
5.3 Second complaint (D17): if the second-highest probability is >= 0.2 (provisional, ADR) and that situation has a different, non-null product_group, Graf steps aside.

5.4 Doctor lists (safety.json class 'doctor' + doctor_rules_with_slots; only inside Graf: here, on every continuation reply, and again before the offer with all slots known — review r3 I5) → doctor.* text, no product.
5.5 Hard exclusions: intolerance to the product or its components → intolerance.answer (no product); diarrhea words → the whole turn routes to situation 'diarrhea', where MAGNIY never appears (NI7).
5.6 Pregnancy situations need a pregnancy word in the message (or the pregnancy slot already true); otherwise route to the situation's 'without_pregnancy_word' neighbour (NI6).
5.7 Routing by the situation's routing rows (selection-rules r2 + D28); first matching 'when' wins.

5.8 Slots, one question per message (question.message = ack + question): who + age (age required); duration for acute situations; temperature for an infant under 6 months with a fever word; sex only if 18–60 and unknown and pregnancy_question = ask; pregnancy only where it changes the product (D28 DN-10). Situations imply slots.

6 Answer from templates.json only: [opening.not_treat when a treat word was written, D32] + acknowledgement + offer + reason per product + dose for the age band + notes; status answer; selection = offered product ids in text order, at most 2 (see 'answer').
7 Product lookup: exact Shop name and form from products.json, exactly one admitted product per id.

uncovered_mode_values.existing_path: step aside to the existing consultant path
uncovered_mode_values.no_product_template: answer with templates.json no_product.general (D30, Captain: 'Б, честный ответ без продукта')

engine.storage: D30 / D14: Graf stores no phrase, no conversation and no queue entry.

answer.order: Offer items are listed primary first, exactly as selection-rules r2 names them (e.g. diarrhea: BIFOLAK, then ZINCUM sticks). Text order = selection order, so ordinals in follow-ups resolve to the right card (NI5).
answer.availability: If one of two products is not admitted or not in stock in the current Shop snapshot, offer only the available one (offer.one with its own reason and dose). If none is available → no_product.unavailable (NI5).
answer.treat_words: D32 (2): messages with лечить / вылечить / назначь (safety.json vocab topic_treat) get Graf's offer like any other; the offer answer starts with opening.not_treat.
answer.magniy_diarrhea_note: note_magniy_diarrhea is prepended to the diarrhea answer only when Jev's top situation was in product_group 'magniy' and the diarrhea words rerouted the turn; otherwise it is not shown (review r3 I8).

hard_exclusions.intolerance: intolerance.answer (product named) or intolerance.answer_no_name; no product; allergy as a complaint ('у него аллергия') is NOT intolerance (NI4).
hard_exclusions.diarrhea: Diarrhea words route the whole turn to situation 'diarrhea' (author's choice, NI7): e.g. 'нервный ребёнок, от стресса понос' → BIFOLAK + ZINCUM sticks, not NEUROCOMPLEX KIDS. MAGNIY never appears with diarrhea words.

second_complaint.rule: D17 / plan r3 §3.5.3: Jev's second-best situation with probability >= 0.2 and a product_group different from the top situation's group → step aside. A null group (clarify-only, no-complaint) never triggers.
second_complaint.threshold_status: provisional; measured once with phrases-two-complaints.json during implementation

slots.age: required for every offer situation; read only with an age marker or as the reply to an age question (safety.json parsers.age, NB4).
slots.whom: optional; one relation per reply, a relation word beats a self word (NI2); used only for wording.
slots.duration: acute_cold and ent; 'N лет / недель' next to a duration word is a duration, never an age.
slots.temperature: asked only for an infant under 6 months with a fever word; needs a unit or a fever word (NS5).
slots.sex: asked only when age is 18–60, sex unknown, and pregnancy_question = 'ask' (D5).
slots.pregnant_or_lactating: asked only for a woman 18–60 when pregnancy_question = 'ask' (D5; D28 DN-10); otherwise set only from pregnancy words; never when the product person is a child or under 15.
slots.form_pref: 'stick' when the text says the person cannot swallow capsules or asks for powder; never asked.
slots.topic: sub-topic words (safety.json vocab topic_*) choose the reason line only, never the product (exception: topic_osteoporosis in bones_50plus, D28 DN-8).
slots.after_clarify: true when the person already answered this situation's clarifying question.

engine.families: 'active' and 'magniy' resolve to capsule or stick by products.json families (age <= 7 → stick; older than 7 → capsules unless form_pref = stick; D28 DN-1).

pregnancy_question_values.ask: ask sex/pregnancy per D5 because the routing changes (immunity → ZINCUM+C+D3)
pregnancy_question_values.detect_only: never asked; set only from pregnancy words; note_pregnancy added then
pregnancy_question_values.implied_yes: a pregnancy situation: allowed only with a pregnancy word, otherwise 'without_pregnancy_word' (NI6)

engine.decisions: D28 (DN-1…DN-12), D30, D31 and D32 applied.
engine.scripts: All safety lists, vocabularies and parsers run on every message in all three scripts (RU, UZ Latin, UZ Cyrillic), whatever request.language is (review r3 I8).
engine.clarify_only_situations: sport_general, child_poor_appetite, womens_health_bare and elderly_bare ask their clarifying question before age; the target situation then asks age (review r3 S6).
engine.product_groups_note: Groups of situations whose offers share products; a second complaint in a different group makes Graf step aside (D17). 'None' = never triggers (clarify-only and no-complaint situations).

situations.jev_criterion: Describes a danger sign that needs an ambulance now: chest pain or pressure, cannot breathe or speak, coughing or vomiting blood, fainting or confusion, blue lips, a rash that does not fade when pressed, a child's seizure with fever, face or throat swelling, self-harm thoughts, or bleeding or severe pain in pregnancy.
situations.jev_criterion_full: Describes a danger sign that needs an ambulance now: chest pain or pressure, cannot breathe or speak, coughing or vomiting blood, fainting or confusion, blue lips, a rash that does not fade when pressed, a child's seizure with fever, face or throat swelling, self-harm thoughts, or bleeding or severe pain in pregnancy. (RU: давит в груди, задыхается, без сознания, судороги с температурой, отёк горла, кровотечение беременна; UZ: ko'kragim siqyapti, nafas ololmayapti, hushidan ketdi, tomog'i shishdi / кўкрагим сиқяпти, нафас ололмаяпти, ҳушидан кетди, томоғи шишди)
situations.note: Detected by safety.json first; the Jev class is a second net only. Self-harm uses template emergency.self_harm; pregnancy signs use emergency.pregnancy.
